d:
Da hindu ke en. ram ke sath ek vishesh batchit men kangres ki purv adhyaksh soniya gandhi apni aane vali aatmaktha bilonging: a jarni oph lav ke bare men bat karti hain. vah batati hain ki bijepi-aaraesaes ke 12 sal ke shasan ne bhartiy loktantr ko kis tarah prabhavit kiya hai. kangres ke lie saman avasron ki laraee ka bachav karte hue vah rajiv gandhi ke sath apni prem kahani ke saphar ko bhi yad karti hain. yah prem kahani dhire-dhire kaise bharat ke prati aajivan pratibaddhata men badal gaee, iski bhi jhalak is batchit men milti hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
